mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly Consumer Price Index increase exceeding 0.3% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy and increase discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.3%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls and declining unemployment rate indicates a tight labor market that fuels wage inflation, triggering Federal Reserve rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline co-occur, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising housing starts signal peak economic momentum and impending business cycle contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly retail sales increase exceeding 0.5% signals robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS monthly change exceeds 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production and GDP indicates economic expansion nearing peak capacity, triggering business cycle contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO and GDPC1 both grow, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-inflation shock regime, sustained federal funds rate increases above 2.5% signal aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during post-inflation shock regimes with FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
